guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 打开 DropWave 预订 portal
guide.description: 前往 Gyndore 预约 portal。旧的 DropWave 活动页面现在重定向至此处，因此任何保存的书签都应放置在同一位置。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Gyndore reservation portal . The old DropWave campaign page now redirects here, so any saved bookmark should land in the same place.

guide.title: 关联你在第一季使用的钱包
guide.description: 预订将附加到现有的第一季个人资料。连接在活动期间收集筹码的相同钱包，因为新钱包没有绑定到它的分配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect the Wallet You Used in Season One
guide.original_description: Reservations attach to existing Season One profiles. Connect the same wallet that collected Chips during the campaign, since a fresh wallet has no allocation tied to it.

guide.title: 验证你的 DropWave 个人资料
guide.description: portal 会在显示余额之前验证你在活动期间链接的 X 帐户。批准登录请求，以便你的 GynPoints 可以与连接的钱包相匹配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The portal verifies the X account you linked during the campaign before it shows a balance. Approve the sign-in request so your GynPoints can be matched to the connected wallet.

guide.title: 确认你的 Base 收货地址
guide.description: 设置应该接收 bGYND 的 Base 地址。使用你持有密钥的地址，因为交易所存款地址通常会拒绝未列出的代币。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Set the Base address that should receive bGYND. Use an address you hold the keys to, because exchange deposit addresses often reject tokens they have not listed.

guide.title: 请在 9 月 9 日前提交
guide.description: 确认预订并检查 portal 是否显示为已预订。 Gyndore 尚未宣布 2026 年 9 月 9 日之后未保留的分配的回退，因此请将该日期视为最终日期。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Confirm the reservation and check that the portal shows it as reserved. Gyndore has not announced a fallback for allocations left unreserved after 09.09.26, so treat the date as final.

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

sourcedSteps.title: Open the DropWave Reservation Portal
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Gyndore reservation portal . The old DropWave campaign page now redirects here, so any saved bookmark should land in the same place.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect the Wallet You Used in Season One
sourcedSteps.body: Reservations attach to existing Season One profiles. Connect the same wallet that collected Chips during the campaign, since a fresh wallet has no allocation tied to it.

sourcedSteps.title: Authenticate Your DropWave Profile
sourcedSteps.body: The portal verifies the X account you linked during the campaign before it shows a balance. Approve the sign-in request so your GynPoints can be matched to the connected wallet.

sourcedSteps.title: Confirm Your Base Receiving Address
sourcedSteps.body: Set the Base address that should receive bGYND. Use an address you hold the keys to, because exchange deposit addresses often reject tokens they have not listed.

sourcedSteps.title: Submit Before September 9
sourcedSteps.body: Confirm the reservation and check that the portal shows it as reserved. Gyndore has not announced a fallback for allocations left unreserved after 09.09.26, so treat the date as final.
